sloka: कच्चित् सुमित्रा धर्मज्ञा जननी लक्ष्मणस्य या ।शत्रुघ्नस्य च वीरस्य सारोगा च अपि मध्यमा ॥२-७०-९॥
transliteration: kaccit sumitrā dharmajñā jananī lakṣmaṇasya yā ।śatrughnasya ca vīrasya sārogā ca api madhyamā ॥2-70-9॥

translations.english: I hope my mother Sumitra (the middle one) who is familiar with the ways of righteousness, the mother of valiant Lakshmana and Satrughna, is enjoying good health.
